title: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.14100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. translated_title: Sckwoky团队参加SHROOM-Visions竞赛：基于双提示LoRA解码器的图像条件视觉语言模型字符级幻觉片段检测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了参加SHROOM-visions 2026共享任务的系统，该任务针对图像条件视觉语言模型（VLM）响应中的字符级幻觉片段检测进行评估，涵盖英语、法语、意大利语和中文四种语言。检测器建立在冻结的Gemma-4-12B-it骨干网络之上，配备可训练的LoRA适配器（约1070万参数）。由于该骨干网络是因果解码器，从单个答案副本读取的隐藏状态无法注意到后续标记；因此我们在同一个提示中重复候选答案，并从其第二次出现的位置提取特征，从而在单次非自回归传递中为每个位置提供近似双向的上下文。字符级定位器结合中间隐藏状态来预测幻觉概率、BIO边界以及响应级弃权分数，同时独立的语言特定分类器为每个预测出的片段分配五种幻觉类型之一。
tldr: 该论文提出了一套基于冻结Gemma-4-12B-it骨干网络与LoRA适配器的字符级幻觉片段检测系统，通过在单一提示中重复候选答案来获取近似双向上下文，可在四种语言上同时预测视觉语言模型响应中的幻觉概率、边界与类型。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a character-level hallucination span detection system built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with LoRA adapters, which repeats candidate answers within a single prompt to obtain approximate bidirectional context, enabling prediction of hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and types across four languages.
